text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"There's still time before training starts.
Just as I thought to organize the data once more—"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Traineeeeee-r!!
Howdyyyyyyyyyy!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Aha, did I surprise you, Trainer?
The surprise was a total success!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Training doesn't start for a while.
I figured you'd have your guard down, so—"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
And right there—BANG!
I dashed over to take aim and shoot!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Phew~~~~, so satisfied♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Did they just want to arrive early and surprise me?
When I asked if there was any particular business—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's right!
Actually, you see—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
choice_data_list: ...Did you sprint a bunch and forget?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Hmm-mm.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
—Well, these things happen!!
As long as you remember when you need to, it's no problem!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
That is RIGHT! Since we're here,
shall we do some TRAINING right now?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"My debut race is just around the corner!
Don't stop me nooow!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, dragged out by Taiki Shuttle, we were supposed to train much earlier than usual, but...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Hum hum humm, today is long, long
training with Trainer~...♪

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Whoops, and what about that 'looks like' part?!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Howdy~, Air Groooooove!!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Guh...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: "...Taiki, you again? How many times do I have to tell you to stop tackling me?!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, sorry!
Air Groove never gets blown away, so I just couldn't help it!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: For the next one, can I go a little more powerful, please?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Cut it out!!
Good grief, what am I going to do with you...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...*Sigh*. Fine, whatever.
More importantly, are you done talking with your trainee?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Since we got permission, let's head over to the work site.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"...Permit?
...Operation?"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ……Don't tell me you forgot?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Weren't you told to carry the materials
for the "Umamusume of the Year" to the library?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: "It looks like we'll need to adjust the training start time now, so I'll go talk to them," you said, and then ran off yourself, you fool!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oooh, that's IT!!
I remember every single bit of it now!!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I was the one who explained every single bit of it!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Feeling a bit guilty,
I decided to help carry the documents.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Whew~! So many documents!
Even with the three of us carrying them, it never ends...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: After all, these are materials on the "Horse of the Year" Umamusume who represented their respective eras.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
It covers a wide range, from race results of course,
to detailed training notes and records on her opponents.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"It's fantastic...!!
As expected of the Umamusume of the Year!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"...And so,
what is this "Horse Girl of the Year"?"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: You're starting from there?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Honestly... In the Twinkle Series,
there are the 'URA Awards' presented to Umamusume
who perform exceptionally throughout the year, aren't there?"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
The URA Awards are divided into several categories,
honoring the top-performing Umamusume in Classic class,
Sprint, Dirt, and more.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"And among them, the one deemed most exceptional...
Shall receive the honor of 'Umamusume of the Year.'"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh!! Weeeell, in other words...
You're saying she's a truly great Umamusume, yes?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Naturally, each and every one of them possessed overwhelming ability, but... that wasn't all.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Records of them will remain like this,
and their stories will continue to be passed down...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: The countless legends woven by heroic figures over generations color the stage of the Twinkle Series—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, everyone dreams a dream
that keeps them utterly captivated on the turf.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
One who kindles the flame of passion in everyone's hearts—
that is what it means to be 'Horse Girl of the Year.'

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After finishing sorting through the documents, I was on my way
to training with Taiki Shuttle when...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Hey, hey, I heard they put together materials about the Horse Girl of the Year in the library!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Whoa, for real? Let's go check it out right away!?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: I'm going, I'm definitely going!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
I'll tell you all about the first person I ever looked up to...
the one who guided me into the world of racing!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
So, so good smile.
It was sparkling.
choice_data_list: It was full of dreams, huh.
It was full of dreams, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Yeees!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: You can find dreams in racing—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: That is the very happiest thing for both Umamusume and fans, yes!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
In dat case... OKAY!!
I have decided!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!!
I—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I WILL become it! The 'Horse Girl of the Year'!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was such an abrupt declaration—so much so
that it could easily be mistaken for one of her usual outlandish remarks.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, the unusually serious gleam in Taiki Shuttle's eyes
was unmistakable—it was the "real deal"!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
A fantastic race!
A great run!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I'll show it to everyone—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Umamusume, fans, family, friends!
And everyone who's about to get to know me!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I'll make every single one of you the most happy you've ever beeeeeen!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Taiki Shuttle's burning passion...
There's no way I can't answer it!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yeeees! "Horse of the Year",
target locked on!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, Taiki Shuttle sprinted forth toward a massive, magnificent dream!
